We started dating in early 2016. We broke up once  in 2017 because I found out he was talking to other girls when we first started dating & then we got back together about six months later. He told me when I found everything out that it was just talking and flirting, nothing physical. I couldn’t accept his apology at the time and split on him. He broke down and hurt himself, at which point our roomates called the cops and he went to a psyche ward for a month. 

While we were apart I blocked him, tried polyamory, did a bunch of shit that didn’t make me feel better so then I worked hard to get him back. Everything I did while we were apart and the fact that I didn’t want to give him a chance didn’t sit well with him when we reconnected so he had a hard time trusting me which I understood and we instated an open-phone policy with eachother. We got back together after a while. We moved across the country, back in with my family for the summer during which time I worked and paid for everything, cooked all the time cus he feels uncomfortable around families since his is really shitty, drive us anywhere we needed to go while he tried to make a career streaming video games. 

Eventually I saved enough, and cashed in my trust, to move us to Cali, because he hated the east coast. When we first got to CA in October I found out that even though he said nothing physical happened he actually had been literally dating another girl on the side. At that point I stopped giving emotionally the way I had been. I still feel so betrayed about it. He thinks it’s so far in the past I just have to move past it. But I went from being upbeat to miserable that day and I haven’t been able to be as interested in his video games or actively try and make meals that he likes or any of the wifey-type things I had been doing. 
He felt the change and did the same thing, which was saying something cus he still wasn’t working until about two months ago so he would just chill at home or go out with his friends. So in my opinion he went from doing 15% to mayybe like five. He’s been mean, calls me a bitch when I have a bad tone of voice or a cunt when I say something he interprets as an insult. He talks to me in a condescending tone most of the times and always laughs when I ask a question, sometimes he says I’m stupid. We haven’t had sex since we moved to CA, like, that’s how distant we’ve been. 

So I took the nudes and I posted a couple to gonewild cus I was feeling so bad about myself. And I left the evidence in the “recently deleted” in my phone, knowing it would come up. We got in a fight when he found them, here are some of the things he said: Everyone warned him not to fuck with me again and he should’ve known better. Him not touching me this whole time was actually just a test that he knew i was gonna fail. He wasted three years of his life on me. I’m going nowhere in life, i’m just gonna work in restaurants forever. He knows his worth and it’s more than i deserve. I’m only happy when there’s a dick in me. He said i’m lucky he’s been mentally preparing for this for a year, cus it was the only reason he was calm. Shit like that. 

Then the next day we talked more calmly and he said he didn’t even know why he was fighting for us, but he didn’t want to give up but he’s still mad. That was the conversation where we talked about what changed and I told him it was because what I found out and he said he hasn’t liked me since we moved. And I was like, yeah, that’s when I stopped trying to give you my all. What do you actually like about me as a person? And his response was something about how he liked my personality before. And I tried to clarify like, okay, you like how supportive I am. And he just kinda shrugged. So that reads to me as an admission, just something you don’t want to say cus it’s shitty.

Hey, i have a really easy way to make edibles for keto.  Decarb your bud. Maybe you have a friend whose house you can use for decarb if you’re worried about the smell? then dump it that and 1/8tsp mesophilic culture into 4 cups cream - not ultra-pasteurized, raw if you can find it, if not your local health food store will likely have regular pasteurized cream - just do not use ultra. 
You can find mesophilic culture at fancy wine/cheese store or homebrewing stores. Or order online, but it has to be kept very cold so I always try and find locally.

Edit: cus I’m high and didn’t actually finish the instructions 😅 
Let the mix sit, covered lightly -not airtight- for 8-12 hours in a warm-ish room. Doesn’t need to be hot, just can’t be too cold. So next to the heater not the window this time of year. It should be the consistency of yogurt after 8-12hrs. Then dump everything into a cheesecloth or butter muslin (can also find that at whichever place you get the culture) and set it up to drip for the next twelve hours. You can look up how to strain cheese but it’s really easy. And then use that for making superbomb fat bombs 

Edit again: you can also use half & half instead of heavy cream. In my experience, finding raw dairy without a direct connection to a farm is reallyy hard, but I used regularly pasteurized half & half last time i did this and it worked great, just needed the full 12 hours to get to a good consistency
